convention_rule: Four similar objects in a left-to-right row; the single green-lit one marks the target. Its ordinal position (1-4) gives the candidate ID number, not the listed order.
basis: Rounds 1-3: the third of four objects (signal, pole, dome, tree, fire) is green or lit, and P3 was revealed each time despite P3's list position changing. Round 4: in A and B the third of four statues/pedestals is lit green, so P3.
